FOOTNOTES

1/ This appropriation is a continuing appropriation and is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ Included in the lump sum appropriation of \$21,565,600 for fiscal year 2025-2026 is \$5,000 for the purchase of mementos and items for visiting officials. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

3/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$21,565,600 from the General Fund in FY 2026 for the operating budget. This amount is unchanged from FY 2025.
